name: Diurnal-Requiem
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by solar wind erosion patterns and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
There is money in platinum, uranium and silicon and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
